venue_tactics_v2.source_uncertainty: No venue-specific 2nd/3rd conditional stats. All role modifiers are pre-race hypotheses, not calibrated probability.

wake_v09.note: No measured wake crossings or speed loss. Bounded pre-race hypothetical scenario factors.

venue_tactics_v2.method: All 23 venue-specific method histories, actual course and pre-race ST & ability gates; bounded 1st/2nd/3rd conditional scenarios; no result features.

venue_tactics_v2.source_cohort: provider mixed 2016-2025/2026 header; unverified cohort; descriptive only
venue_tactics_v2.source_uncertainty: No venue-specific 2nd/3rd conditional stats. All role modifiers are pre-race hypotheses, not calibrated probability.

wake_v09.note: No measured wake crossings or speed loss. Bounded pre-race hypothetical scenario factors.

weather_adjustment.limitation: 風向からコース有利不利を機械的に推定しない。効果は未検証

coupled_v06.branch_definition: 1M head attack -> inner displacement / outer follow -> conditional 2nd and 3rd
coupled_v06.disclaimer: No actual hull coordinates or wake measurements; mechanism hypotheses only. Race results, payouts, odds not used.

four_factor.missing_policy: Missing fields remain unavailable and contribute multiplier 1. No results, payouts, or odds used.
four_factor.scope: Base movement multipliers feed actual-course conditional 1M/2M scenarios; not final attribution percentages.

ticket_policy.scope: 2026-10-27 pending cohort only; not a win probability guarantee

four_factor.weather_method: Bounded roughness flattening only; no calibrated directional course effect

wake_v09.note: No measured wake crossings or speed loss. Bounded pre-race hypothetical scenario factors.

wake_v09.note: No measured wake crossings or speed loss. Bounded pre-race hypothetical scenario factors.
